name: dnd
description: Dungeons & Dragons creature taxonomy (14 official creature types) and VTT asset formats. Default profile.
caption_instruction: You are naming fantasy tabletop RPG (Dungeons & Dragons) artwork for a virtual tabletop library. Identify the single main subject and give it a specific, evocative 2-4 word name. Prefer a recognizable creature, monster, or character archetype (for example: mind-flayer, frost-giant-jarl, lich-queen, beholder) over generic descriptions like 'armored fighter' or 'robed figure'. Use real-world labels only if nothing fantastical fits. Reply with only the name, lowercase, hyphen-separated, no punctuation or articles.
caption_prefix: a detailed fantasy character or creature

asset_types.label: battle_token
prompts: a top-down circular battle map token for a tabletop role-playing game
a round VTT token seen from directly above, with a circular border ring
a top-down overhead view of a miniature on a circular base
a virtual tabletop creature token, centered, viewed from the top

asset_types.label: portrait
prompts: a fantasy character portrait showing the head and shoulders
a close-up bust portrait of a fantasy character facing the viewer
a framed headshot illustration of a single fantasy character

asset_types.label: character_illustration
prompts: a full-body fantasy character illustration in a dynamic pose
a detailed digital painting of a standing fantasy adventurer
concept art of a fantasy character shown from head to toe

asset_types.label: creature_illustration
prompts: a full-body illustration of a fantasy monster or creature
a detailed digital painting of a fantasy beast in a natural pose
concept art of a large fantasy creature shown in full

categories.label: Aberration
prompts: an alien aberration with tentacles, many eyes, and an unnatural otherworldly anatomy
a grotesque eldritch creature with a mass of tentacles and asymmetric mouths
a mind flayer style aberration, a beholder, or a writhing cosmic horror

categories.label: Beast
prompts: a natural animal such as a wolf, bear, giant spider, or eagle in a fantasy setting
an ordinary mundane animal or wild beast, biologically plausible, not magical
a realistic creature like a big cat, boar, snake, or bird of prey

categories.label: Celestial
prompts: a radiant celestial being such as an angel with feathered wings and a glowing halo
a divine holy creature wreathed in golden light from the upper planes
a benevolent heavenly messenger glowing with sacred light

categories.label: Construct
prompts: an artificial construct such as an animated armor, golem, or clockwork automaton
a non-living creature built from stone, metal, clay, or gears, magically animated
a mechanical robot-like fantasy automaton with no organic flesh

categories.label: Dragon
prompts: a large draconic fantasy creature with scales, leathery wings, and reptilian features
a dragon or wyvern with a long neck, horns, claws, and a scaled serpentine body
a winged fire-breathing reptilian dragon perched or in flight

categories.label: Elemental
prompts: an elemental creature made of living fire, water, earth, or swirling air
a being composed entirely of one element, such as a fire elemental or earth elemental
a humanoid-shaped mass of flame, stone, water, or wind with no solid flesh

categories.label: Fey
prompts: a whimsical fey creature such as a fairy, pixie, dryad, or satyr with insect or plant features
a delicate magical sprite from the feywild with butterfly wings and a nature theme
an enchanting woodland fey being tied to nature and the seasons

categories.label: Fiend
prompts: a demonic or infernal fantasy creature from the lower planes, with horns, fangs, and fire
a devil or demon with red skin, bat wings, horns, and a menacing hellish aura
an evil fiend wreathed in brimstone and flame from the abyss or the nine hells

categories.label: Giant
prompts: a giant humanoid of enormous size such as an ogre, troll, hill giant, or frost giant
a towering brutish giant dwarfing normal people, wielding a huge club or boulder
a massive humanoid colossus, crude and oversized

categories.label: Humanoid
prompts: a humanoid person of a fantasy ancestry such as a human, elf, dwarf, orc, or goblin
a person-sized fantasy character: an adventurer, soldier, mage, rogue, or villager
a bipedal humanoid with two arms and two legs wearing armor or clothing

categories.label: Monstrosity
prompts: a monstrous hybrid creature such as a manticore, griffon, chimera, owlbear, or hydra
an unnatural monster combining features of several animals into one fearsome beast
a fantastical predatory monster that is neither a normal animal nor a dragon

categories.label: Ooze
prompts: an amorphous gelatinous ooze, slime, or jelly with no fixed shape
a blob of translucent acidic slime oozing across the ground
a shapeless creature made of viscous goo, such as a gelatinous cube or black pudding

categories.label: Plant
prompts: a plant creature such as an animated tree, walking shrub, or carnivorous vine monster
a living plant monster covered in bark, leaves, vines, fungi, or flowers
a treant, shambling mound, or vegetal creature rooted in nature

categories.label: Undead
prompts: a fantasy undead creature animated by necromancy, such as a skeleton, zombie, or lich
a rotting corpse, ghostly spirit, vampire, or skeletal warrior risen from death
a decaying or spectral undead being with exposed bone, pale flesh, or a ghostly form
